plugins.name: repo-spend
plugins.description: A bar above the prompt: dollars spent on the current repo over the time your logs cover, and this session's live spend and burn rate

plugins.name: coach
plugins.description: A weekly coach for how you use Claude Code: one habit at a time from your own sessions, tips at your level, CLAUDE.md lines and skills worth making, and your progress over the weeks

plugins.name: games
plugins.description: Small, good-looking games in a side pane: /games for Snake, Tetris, Breakout, Dino Run, Pong, 2048, Minesweeper, Lights Out, Memory, Connect Four, Tic-tac-toe, Wordle and Hangman, with milestones and your progress saved

plugins.name: worklog
plugins.description: What you worked on, day by day, across every repo: /standup for the last work day, /worklog for any day, by PR and branch with the time spent

plugins.name: worktrees
plugins.description: Every git worktree of the repo in a pane: /worktree shows how stale each is, its size on disk, which ones a Claude session is using, and removes the ones you're done with
